WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT 
    CENTROMEA,
    HGB,
    CASE 
      WHEN `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE != 0 
      THEN `T-BIL` / CRE 
      ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14'
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    CENTROMEA,
    AVG(HGB) as avg_hgb,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_data
  GROUP BY CENTROMEA
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_of_averages
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
  g.CENTROMEA,
  g.avg_hgb,
  g.avg_ratio,
  g.avg_ratio / o.mean_of_averages as normalized_ratio
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
WHERE o.mean_of_averages IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY g.CENTROMEA
